description: Installs the mikefarah/yq YAML processor from a sha256-pinned binary release. No package manager is used, so it works on any distro with curl.
name: yq

sha256.description: sha256 of the yq_linux_amd64 asset for the given version. Must be updated together with version.

version.description: yq version to install, without a leading 'v'.
